recipe.visualDefinition: A central dark oval vignette containing a group of musicians, framed by a lush, hand-painted floral wreath of roses and leaves, set against a textured, sepia-toned background with a deckle-edge border.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark central void contrasting with a light, textured outer frame
Organic floral wreath acting as a bridge between the subject and the background
Muted, earthy color palette unifying disparate elements
Hand-drawn script integrated into the upper floral arrangement
coreInvariants: Symmetrical floral wreath framing the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The band is centered within a dark oval, occupying approximately 30% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, pale pink rose at the bottom center of the wreath.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central band, move outward to the floral wreath, and follow the circular path around to the top-corner typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark void behind the band provides high-contrast negative space that makes the subjects pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sepia and tan (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted reds, pinks, and greens (floral wreath)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the central black oval and the surrounding light tan background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters feature exaggerated loops that blend into the floral motifs

composition.position: top corners, following the curve of the wreath

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative script paired with illustrative elements.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the formal yet fluid script quality.
Provides the necessary flourishes and high contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1970s oil painting style image. Center a group of 4-5 musicians in a dark black oval vignette. Surround the oval with a thick, symmetrical wreath of hand-painted roses and autumn leaves in muted reds and pinks. The entire composition should be on a textured, sepia-toned canvas with wavy vertical patterns and a rough deckle-edge border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered script in dark brown ink along the top curve of the floral wreath. The lettering should be a flourished Copperplate style that appears to be part of the original painting.

verificationChecks: Does the central oval have a deep black void?
Is the floral wreath hand-painted in style rather than photographic?
Is the background texture visible and sepia-toned?
Does the typography follow the curve of the wreath?

mustAchieve: Organic integration of text and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the wreath is not perfectly symmetrical to maintain a hand-drawn feel.
Check that the dark vignette doesn't have hard edges but blends into the flowers.
Verify the deckle edge looks like torn paper.
Confirm the script is legible but decorative.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Subject] in [Color] vignette + [Floral/Organic] framing wreath + [Textured/Sepia] background + [Flourished Script] typography.
